title: Add $0.50 paid access requirement (paywall) to use the app

requirements.text: Add backend support for paid access by tracking whether each caller (Principal) has unlocked the app and exposing an API to query the caller’s paid/unlocked status.

quotes: Users need to pay $0.50 to use app

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores a per-user (Principal) boolean or equivalent flag representing whether the user has paid/unlocked access.
Backend exposes a query method that returns the caller’s current access status (paid/unlocked vs locked).
Access status is scoped per caller and does not leak other users’ status.

requirements.text: Enforce paid access on the backend by preventing unpaid users from recording water intake or fetching weekly summaries.

quotes: Users need to pay $0.50 to use app

acceptanceCriteria: If an unpaid/locked caller invokes recordIntake, the call fails with a clear error (or returns a clear rejected result) indicating payment is required.
If an unpaid/locked caller invokes getWeeklySummary, the call fails with a clear error (or returns a clear rejected result) indicating payment is required.
Paid/unlocked callers can use recordIntake and getWeeklySummary with the same behavior as before.

requirements.text: Implement the payment flow to unlock access for $0.50 and persist the unlocked state for the logged-in user.

quotes: Users need to pay $0.50 to use app

acceptanceCriteria: The app offers a payment flow for a fixed price of $0.50 to unlock usage.
After a successful payment, the backend marks the user as paid/unlocked and subsequent app loads reflect the unlocked state.
If payment is not completed or fails, the user remains locked and cannot use hydration tracking features.
The flow requires the user to be authenticated (Internet Identity) so the unlock can be tied to their Principal.

requirements.text: Add a frontend paywall experience that blocks the hydration tracker UI until the user has paid $0.50, and provides clear English user-facing messaging for login, payment, and unlock status.

quotes: Users need to pay $0.50 to use app

acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not unlocked, the main app functionality (Daily Log and Weekly Summary) is not usable and a paywall screen/overlay is shown instead.
The paywall UI includes: (1) a prompt to sign in with Internet Identity if not signed in, (2) a button to start the $0.50 payment, and (3) clear status/error text in English.
After the backend reports the user is unlocked, the paywall is dismissed and the existing tracker UI works normally.
If the backend returns a payment-required error for hydration calls, the frontend handles it gracefully by showing the paywall (not a raw crash).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if required for state upgrades.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Use English for any user-facing UI text.
nonGoals: Subscriptions, recurring billing, coupons, multiple pricing tiers, or promo codes.
Third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity.
Real-time features (WebSockets), email/SMS receipts/notifications, or external databases.
